whitelist_criteria.walk_forward_stability: Consistent positive expectancy across Train, Validation, and Out-of-Sample
whitelist_criteria.cost_inclusion: Real broker spread, commission, and adverse slippage included

summary.rationale: No candidate combination met the multi-period stability criteria. While sample size starvation was eliminated (generating 100-258 trades per instrument on M15), and localized OOS gains appeared in XAUUSD M5 and SOLUSDT M15 under Begonya Macro, Train/Validation divergence confirms lack of stationary edge under real broker transaction costs.
